gate_B7.comparison: signal-aware algo (B2 urgency / B3 pacing) vs the plain algo of the same name on the SAME windows, same policy, same size cell
gate_B7.cost_basis: the signed run uses configs/prereg/v2.json realism opt-ins and impact_model=parent with the fitted exponent; the exponent and its fit support are recorded here by fingerprint before signing, never read at run time (the driver does not yet apply v2.json realism: B2/B3 add that wiring before signature)
gate_B7.eligibility: a cell whose depth_exhausted parent share exceeds 0.25 under either arm is reported but not gate-eligible (its cost is the walk cap, not the algo)
gate_B7.fill_rate_condition: signal-aware fill rate not lower than plain by more than 0.02 (paired, same clustering)
gate_B7.multiplicity: Holm over the four algos; a cell passes only if both the cost and the fill-rate conditions hold
gate_B7.no_look: the fresh days are not read until this draft is signed and registered (tools/*_register.py, --require-ci-env)
report_always: depth_exhausted parent share and qty share of unfilled
gate_B7.sessions_for_signature: IEX fresh days plus the Nasdaq/IEX overlap days only; the multi7 in-sample sessions are NOT used for the gate and are not padded with IEX days
gate_B7.statistic: paired per-parent difference signal-aware - plain in all_in bps, mean with day-clustered SE (one cluster per session), Student-t with G - 1 df

holdout: data/real/r7_holdout and the 2026 holdout are never read by this benchmark; the signed test runs once on the IEX fresh days and the Nasdaq/IEX overlap days (B7)
primary_metric: all_in bps per parent (shortfall + fees_net + sim_impact + completion), labelled replay + linear child adder (rule 6)
registration_tool: tools/b7_shortfall_register.py <root> --dry-run --require-ci-env (owner only; refuses until every field above is filled)

signal_arm.ac_drift: IS cells only: native+ac_drift vs native+ac (plain Almgren-Chriss, sigma = price * 0.015 per sqrt(day), eta from the simulator slope, lambda 1e-6)
signal_arm.alpha: OPEN (owner): EQ10 (registered beta < 0, synthetic fit; real in-sample IC > 0) or EQ05; the arm must be fixed here before signing
signal_arm.alpha_id: OPEN (owner): EQ10 or EQ05 - the in-sample run used EQ10 registered
signal_arm.pacing: pov_signal_pacing (POV) / slice_signal_tilt (TWAP, VWAP, IS) with PacingParams(gain=0.5, min_scale=0.25, max_scale=3.0, max_participation=0.5); policies native+pacing vs native
signal_arm.source: AlphaUrgencySource.from_dataset(<alpha>, <dataset>/features, params=configs/strategies/alpha_params.json) unless the owner chooses --signal-refit (labelled refit:in-sample, in-sample only)
signal_arm.thresholds: OPEN (owner): the in-sample run used threshold_z 1.0, passive_urgency 0.1, gain 0.5 (clip 0.25-3), max_age 10 s
signal_arm.thresholds_status: OPEN (owner): threshold_z and gain are the driver defaults, not tuned; any tuning happens in-sample and is recorded here before signing
signal_arm.units: z-score of the alpha's expected_return per instrument on the gate dataset (iap.execution.signal)
signal_arm.urgency: ParentOrder(urgency_policy='alpha', alpha_urgency=AlphaUrgencyPolicy(threshold_z=1.0, passive_urgency=0.1, max_age_ns=10 s)) on the native child style; policies native+urgency vs native

simulator.note: costs are replay + adder: simulated fills never move the replayed book; the signed run uses configs/prereg/v2.json realism opt-ins and impact_model=parent with the fitted exponent (label recorded at run time); walk depth 50 (the depth-50 comparison, research/execution/benchmark/DEPTH_COMPARISON_multi7.md)
